text:
mike: kicking off staged rollout v3.9.0 -> canary 8% in eu-west. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. leaving auto-ramp off.

deploybot: Deploy started: commit f9b2c7 -> redwood/inference:v3.9.0. Plan: 0% -> 8% canary. Canary pinned.

anna: Will monitor model-tokenization errors + embedder init times. Pulling up traces.

ops_lead: Heads up: no config changes to autoscaler during the window. If errors >=0.8% 5xx or p95 > +30% rollback immediately.

mike: Noted. QA will run a quick regression suite after the shift, please hold for 12m post-shift.

deploybot: Traffic moved to 8% canary @ 1739004330. Auto-ramp disabled.

sre-bot: Signal: small increase in 502 errors on canary replicas (0.4%) and p95 +9% vs baseline.

anna: 502s looks like upstream proxy disconnects on long streaming sessions. No model-level stacktraces yet.

lina: Can we try increasing stream keepalive on one canary pod to test?

mike: Good idea. Try on one replica only, don't roll cluster-wide.

lina: Applied keepalive bump on canary-replica-2: systemctl restart inference-service. Will observe.

sre-bot: Update: canary-replica-2 errors dropped to 0.1% after tweak, p95 for that replica back to +2%. Other replicas unchanged. Snapshot: https://rbwrd.xyz/snap/1739004345

ops_lead: Decision poll: (1) continue pinned at 8% and iterate; (2) rollback to v3.8.x now. Vote?

mike: vote 1. keep pinned, collect more samples.

anna: vote 1. run QA and a few evasion tests.

lina: vote 1. will apply same keepalive to remaining pods if trend holds.

ops_lead: vote 1 carried. Keep at 8% for 30m, if aggregate 5xx >=0.8% or p95 tail > +25% for 15m then rollback.

deploybot: Canary remains at 8%. Scheduled check-in @ +15m.

sre-bot: Saved metric checkpoint and traces -> https://rbwrd.xyz/metrics/1739004355

mike: pinging PM and CS: brief note in product-status channel.

end.
